reason: I already paid for a DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, and this is the same thing with a nicer name. $147 a month is a lot when I haven't landed my next client, and I'm not putting a card down for something with no customer results.
objection: It still sends DMs automatically from my own Instagram, and that's what got me action blocked last time. There are no published results, and 7 of 100 seats taken doesn't tell me anyone got a client. After day 3 the payments are final, so if it flops I'm out $147.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from someone my size, like screenshots of replies and booked calls from a founding member, plus a lower price and a clear refund if my account gets flagged.
